shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
rg -n \"beforeSession|afterSession|onError\" src test tests specs package.json .lore/test-commands.yml 2>/dev/null | head -240
sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts
sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml
command -v lore-query-trace || true"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts
sed -n '240,370p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts
sed -n '1,90p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts
sed -n '1,70p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
ls -1 | rg -i 'change|package-lock|yarn|pnpm'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.+#[0-9]+|spec:\" src scripts | head -80
sed -n '1,35p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts
sed -n '1,100p' CHANGELOG.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md
if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; fi
git diff --check
git diff -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md
git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && git commit -m "Handle beforeSession failures through lifecycle hooks" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
